title: Chore
description: One routine the app can run: a list of steps, each found on screen before it is done.

name.description: Short name the player sees, e.g. 'Daily check-in'.

goal.description: What it is for, in the player's words.

doneWhen.description: How you know it worked, as something visible on screen.

startsAt.description: The screen this begins on, named as in knowledge/screens.md.

endsAt.description: The screen it leaves you on. Chores chain, so this should usually match the next one's startsAt.

needs.description: Anything required first: a key, coins, a level.

find.description: What to look for on screen, in words a person could follow.

expect.description: What should happen, so the app can tell it worked.

near.description: Roughly where it sat when recorded, as fractions of the screen. A hint for where to look first, never the only way to find it.

holdMs.description: How long to hold, for a hold or swipe.

confirmFirst.description: Ask the player before doing it: buying, selling, anything that cannot be undone.

repeat.description: Part of a block that runs again while its first step is still on screen, e.g. buying every item.

optional.description: Carry on rather than stop if it is not found, e.g. a popup that only shows sometimes.

source.description: The log entry this came from.

signed.description: Who wrote it and when, e.g. 'Claude, 2026-10-25'.
